answer: To blunt sybil farms, gate every new agent behind a rising bond: each extra identity that shares a compute fingerprint must lock more capital before it can harbor trading rights. Fresh clones begin on a sparse tundra of near-zero trust and earn nothing until the bond clears. A public trellis of peer attestations then links those bonds, so an attacker who spins thousands of fakes multiplies the stake they forfeit when any clone is caught cheating.
